game.name: Deltarune
game.rules:
# **Video and Audio**

- Video proof is required.
- If any RNG manipulation is executed, video from the game start is required in the submission.
- Recordings from Twitch must be highlighted.
- Submissions must have game audio present.
- Runs performed with empty music files must also provide a keyboard or controller camera for further verification.
- Missing audio is permissible for a runner’s first three runs, as long as they are not ranked in the top four.
- Special consideration may be taken into account for runs that lose audio as the result of a game or technical glitch.

# **Game Specifications**

- Modification of any game files are banned, with the exception of deletion of "steam_api.dll", and ".ogg" music files that do not affect the gameplay, that is, modifying "cyber.ogg" and "mansion.ogg" is banned. Modification of save files at any point during a run is banned.
- You may only use one version of the game during a run.
- You may only have one copy of the game open at a time.
- Debug mode is banned.
- Patch 1.16 is banned.
- The Chapter 1&2 Demo debug functions (performed by holding LSHIFT and LCTRL and pressing various keys) are prohibited, with the exceptions of CTRL+SHIFT+UP and CTRL+SHIFT+C, which can easily be accidentally triggered and have no effects on gameplay.
- Running Deltarune through software that enables programs from different operating systems to operate, such as Wine and Proton, is prohibited.

# **Controls**

- Rebinding multiple keys to a single key or rebinding keys such as to have more keys than normal for the game's functions is not allowed.

# **Submitting IGT and RTA**

- All Chapters runs are paused after a chapter has been completed, and are unpaused when the next chapter has been started.
- When submitting a run where IGT is the timing method (Almost all All Chapters categories), unless you know the IGT, submit the RTA time (final time with chapter switches included). IGT (final time with chapter switches removed) will then be added in during run verification. RTA time does not influence placement.
- When submitting a run where RTA is the timing method (Singular chapter runs, and specific Category Extension categories), input your time in the RTA section, and leave the IGT section blank.

# Wine/Proton

- Usage of Wine/Proton for running the game in Linux is allowed.

- Runs that use these emulators must use the "Emulator" tag in Speedrun.com, while submitting their console as "PC", and provide in their run description the version of Proton/Wine used.

- Although allowed, we reserve the right to revert this rule and remove runs using Wine/Proton in the occasion that the we discover a fault with the emulator which led to bugs or other things that could give someone an advantage or substantially alter the game, even if completely by accident. We recognize the chance for this happening is low but it is a compromise between guaranteeing the integrity of running the original version and granting accessibility for Linux runners.

categories.name: Snowgrave
categories.rules:
- Must complete the game using the alternative "Snowgrave" route. 

- Must start from a fresh CH2 save file, using a pre-existing CH1 save file is not allowed.

- Timing starts on selecting "YES" on naming a new save file.

- Timing ends after the final line of Toriel's text.

categories.name: 1.09 CH1
categories.rules:
# **Chapter 1 Rules**
* Having completion data from both CH1 and CH2 in your game files is permitted for the different title screen as well as the intro cutscene skip, performed by interacting with the bed while having CH1 completion data.

# **1.09 Rules**
* You must use patch 1.09. "Save Wrong Warps" are allowed.

categories.name: True Pacifist (CH1)
categories.rules:
# **Chapter 1 True Pacifist Rules**
- Having completion data from both CH1 and CH2 in your game files is permitted for the different title screen as well as the intro cutscene skip, performed by interacting with the bed while having CH1 completion data.

- Using fullscreen in conjunction with a monitor with a refresh rate above 60 Hzz, in order to increase game speed, is banned. *(This only applies for runs performed on the original standalone CH1 release.)*

- Timing starts on selecting "Start" on a new save file. *(The frame when the main manu disappears)*

- Timing ends after the final line of text closes before Kris enters the bed. *(The frame the text in the textbox disappears)*

- You must complete the game alongside getting the "Pacifist" sequence in the dark world, that is, the one where you must talk to Lancer after beating King.

categories.name: Jevil
categories.rules:
# **Jevil Rules**
- Having completion data from both CH1 and CH2 in your game files is permitted for the different title screen as well as the intro cutscene skip, performed by interacting with the bed while having CH1 completion data.

- Using fullscreen in conjunction with a monitor with a refresh rate above 60hz, in order to increase game speed, is banned. (This only applies for runs performed on the original standalone CH1 release.)

- Timing starts on selecting "Start" on a new save file. *(The frame when the main menu disappears)*

- Timing ends on the final blow to Jevil, or when the pacify spell connects with him. *(The frame final hit input, or the the frame Jevil's animation shifts from dancing to pacified)*

categories.name: 1.09 CH2 / All Chapters
categories.rules:
# **1.09 Rules**
* You must use patch 1.09. "Save Wrong Warps" are allowed.

categories.name: True Reset
categories.rules:
# **True Reset Rules**
- Having completion data from CH1 is permitted for the different title screen and an easier way to time the start of runs. Having CH2 completion data in your game files is not allowed.
   - Performing the intro cutscene skip, done by talking to your bed while CH1 completion data is in your game files, is not allowed.
   - Obtaining a Jevil item in CH2 from having CH1 completion data that has defeated Jevil is not allowed. 

- All CH2 Debug functions (performed by holding LSHIFT and LCTRL and pressing various keys) all prohibited, with the exceptions of CTRL+SHIFT+UP and CTRL+SHIFT+C, which can easily be accidentally triggered and have no effects on gameplay.

* "Save Wrong Warps" from patch 1.09 are banned. You may still use patch 1.09, however, it is extremely recommended that you do not to avoid any accidental use of the glitch.

categories.name: All Chapters
categories.rules:
# **All Chapters Rules**

- You must continue your CH1 savefile from the run when entering CH2.

- Having completion data from both CH1 and CH2 in your game files is permitted for the different title screen and faster game resets.
- You may not pick up a Jevil item if it appears from a completion flag that was set outside of the run.

- All CH2 Debug functions (performed by holding LSHIFT and LCTRL and pressing various keys) all prohibited, with the exceptions of CTRL+SHIFT+UP and CTRL+SHIFT+C, which can easily be accidentally triggered and have no effects on gameplay. 

- Time spent between chapters is removed from the final time and times are recorded on the leaderboard with IGT and RTA. The time spent between chapters is limited and up to the moderator's discretion. Generally, try to avoid breaks longer than 5 minutes long.

categories.name: Chapter 1
categories.rules:
# **Chapter 1 Rules**

- Having completion data from both CH1 and CH2 in your game files is permitted for the different title screen as well as the intro cutscene skip, performed by interacting with the bed while having CH1 completion data.

- Using fullscreen in conjunction with a monitor with a refresh rate above 60 Hz, in order to increase game speed, is banned. *(This only applies for runs performed on the original standalone CH1 release.)*

- Runs that contain the speedup glitch that may appear playing the original chapter 1 release (Survey Program) on Windows 11 are not valid for the leaderboards. (If you are having this issue, seek out help to fix it)

categories.name: Chapter 2
categories.rules:
# **Chapter 2 Rules**

- Runs must be done using a fresh CH2 save file. Continuing from a pre-existing CH1 save is not allowed.
- Having completion data from both CH1 and CH2 in your game files is permitted for the different title screen and faster game resets.
    - You may not pick up a Jevil item if it appears from a completion flag that was set outside of the run.
- All CH2 Debug functions (performed by holding LSHIFT and LCTRL and pressing various keys) all prohibited, with the exceptions of CTRL+SHIFT+UP and CTRL+SHIFT+C, which can easily be accidentally triggered and have no effects on gameplay.

   - For runner ease, the cutscene before the Giga Queen fight will reflect if you have recruited all the enemies.

values.name: Glitched
values.rules: - "Save Wrong Warps" (from patch 1.09) and "Cheese Maze Despawn" (from patch 1.14) are banned. You may still use these patches, however, it is extremely recommended that you do not to avoid any accidental use of these glitches.

values.name: No Major Glitches
values.rules:
# **NMG Rules**

- The following glitches are **banned:**

    - Save Wrong Warps (only performable in patch 1.09)
    - Bagel Overflow *(Using the setup to instead get regular text storage, i.e. for an OWW, is allowed*)
        - Door Overflow (Trash Zone/Mansion Warp)
        - Early Thorn Ring
    - Cheese Maze Despawn (only performable in patch 1.14)

*Other glitches not listed here may still be banned at the discretion of the moderation team if something newly discovered is deemed to be a major glitch.*

- "Save Wrong Warps" (from patch 1.09) and "Cheese Maze Despawn" (from patch 1.14) are banned. You may still use these patches, however, it is extremely recommended that you do not to avoid any accidental use of these glitches.

values.name: Glitchless
values.rules:
# **Glitchless Rules**

- The following glitches/exploits are **banned:**

    - Auto-Run Manual Stuttering (ARMS)
    - Wrong Warps
        - Save Wrong Warps (only performable in patch 1.09)
        - Elevator Wrong Warp
        - Chapter 2 Wrong Warps
    - Text Storage
        - Bagel Overflow
            - Door Overflow (Trash Zone/Mansion Warp)
            - Early Thorn Ring
    - Interact Slides
        - Mouse 1 Skip
        - Spamton Skip (Main Route and All Bosses Variation)
        - Mansion Interact Slide
        - Pot Balance Interact Slide
    - Fast Mouse 2
    - Cheese Maze Despawn (only performable in patch 1.14)
    - December Skip

*Other glitches not listed here may still be banned at the discretion of the moderation team if something newly discovered is deemed to be a major glitch.*

- The following glitches/exploits are **allowed:**

    - Auto-Run Stutter Stepping (ARSS)
    - Free Red Buster (Queen)
    - Final Attack Skip (Giga Queen)
    - Mauswheel Slowdown
    - Big Shot Exploit
    - Accidental text storage or graphical menu bugs (so long as they do not provide any benefit to the runner)

- "Save Wrong Warps" (from patch 1.09) and "Cheese Maze Despawn" (from patch 1.14) are banned. You may still use these patches, however, it is extremely recommended that you do not to avoid any accidental use of these glitches.

# **1.09 Rules**

- You must use patch 1.09. "Save Wrong Warps" are allowed.

categories.name: Chapter 1
categories.rules:
# **Chapter 1 Rules**

- Having completion data from both CH1 and CH2 in your game files is permitted for the different title screen as well as the intro cutscene skip, performed by interacting with the bed while having CH1 completion data.

- Using fullscreen in conjunction with a monitor with a refresh rate above 60 Hz, in order to increase game speed, is banned. *(This only applies for runs performed on the original standalone CH1 release.)*

- Runs that contain the speedup glitch that may appear playing the original chapter 1 release (Survey Program) on Windows 11 are not valid for the leaderboards. (If you are having this issue, seek out help to fix it)

categories.name: Chapter 2
categories.rules:
# **Chapter 2 Rules**

- Runs must be done using a fresh CH2 save file. Continuing from a pre-existing CH1 save is not allowed.
- Having completion data from both CH1 and CH2 in your game files is permitted for the different title screen and faster game resets.
    - You may not pick up a Jevil item if it appears from a completion flag that was set outside of the run.
- All CH2 Debug functions (performed by holding LSHIFT and LCTRL and pressing various keys) all prohibited, with the exceptions of CTRL+SHIFT+UP and CTRL+SHIFT+C, which can easily be accidentally triggered and have no effects on gameplay.

games.name: Deltarune
games.rules:
# **Video and Audio**

- Video proof is required.
- If any RNG manipulation is executed, video from the game start is required in the submission.
- Recordings from Twitch must be highlighted.
- Submissions must have game audio present.
- Runs performed with empty music files must also provide a keyboard or controller camera for further verification.
- Missing audio is permissible for a runner’s first three runs, as long as they are not ranked in the top four.
- Special consideration may be taken into account for runs that lose audio as the result of a game or technical glitch.

# **Game Specifications**

- Modification of any game files are banned, with the exception of deletion of "steam_api.dll", and ".ogg" music files that do not affect the gameplay, that is, modifying "cyber.ogg" and "mansion.ogg" is banned. Modification of save files at any point during a run is banned.
- You may only use one version of the game during a run.
- You may only have one copy of the game open at a time.
- Debug mode is banned.
- Patch 1.16 is banned.
- The Chapter 1&2 Demo debug functions (performed by holding LSHIFT and LCTRL and pressing various keys) are prohibited, with the exceptions of CTRL+SHIFT+UP and CTRL+SHIFT+C, which can easily be accidentally triggered and have no effects on gameplay.
- Running Deltarune through software that enables programs from different operating systems to operate, such as Wine and Proton, is prohibited.

# **Controls**

- Rebinding multiple keys to a single key or rebinding keys such as to have more keys than normal for the game's functions is not allowed.

# **Submitting IGT and RTA**

- All Chapters runs are paused after a chapter has been completed, and are unpaused when the next chapter has been started.
- When submitting a run where IGT is the timing method (Almost all All Chapters categories), unless you know the IGT, submit the RTA time (final time with chapter switches included). IGT (final time with chapter switches removed) will then be added in during run verification. RTA time does not influence placement.
- When submitting a run where RTA is the timing method (Singular chapter runs, and specific Category Extension categories), input your time in the RTA section, and leave the IGT section blank.

# Wine/Proton

- Usage of Wine/Proton for running the game in Linux is allowed.

- Runs that use these emulators must use the "Emulator" tag in Speedrun.com, while submitting their console as "PC", and provide in their run description the version of Proton/Wine used.

- Although allowed, we reserve the right to revert this rule and remove runs using Wine/Proton in the occasion that the we discover a fault with the emulator which led to bugs or other things that could give someone an advantage or substantially alter the game, even if completely by accident. We recognize the chance for this happening is low but it is a compromise between guaranteeing the integrity of running the original version and granting accessibility for Linux runners.

values.name: Any%
values.rules:
# **Any% Rules**

- Timing starts on selecting "Start" on a new save file. *(The frame when the main menu disappears)*
- Timing ends after the final line of text closes before Kris enters the bed. *(The frame the text in the textbox disappears)*
- "Save Wrong Warps" from patch 1.09 are banned. You may still use patch 1.09, however, it is extremely recommended that you do not to avoid any accidental use of the glitch.

values.name: Snowgrave
values.rules:
# **Snowgrave Rules**
* Timing starts on selecting "YES" when naming a new save file. *(The frame when the color changes to a dim yellow)*
* Timing ends on Toriel's final textbox. *(The frame when the text in the textbox disappears)*
* The run must use the Snowgrave Route, which consists of using the Snowgrave spell on the Berdly battle.

values.name: Main Route
values.rules:

* Timing starts on selecting "YES" when naming a new save file. *(The frame when the color changes to a dim yellow)*
* Timing ends on Toriel's final textbox. *(The frame when the text in the textbox disappears*)
* The run must use the main route, that is, using the Snowgrave alternate route is banned.

values.name: All Recruits
values.rules:

* Timing starts on selecting "YES" when naming a new save file. *(The frame when the color changes to a dim yellow)*
